jsesh.hieroglyphs
Class ResourcesHieroglyphicFontManager

java.lang.Object
  jsesh.hieroglyphs.ResourcesHieroglyphicFontManager
All Implemented Interfaces:
HieroglyphicFontManager
public class ResourcesHieroglyphicFontManager
extends java.lang.Object
implements HieroglyphicFontManager

Font manager which takes its data from a resource bundle. The signs will be stored as SVG files in the location given as resourcePath, and their names shall be all lowercase. The list of the signs will be stored in the same location, as an ASCII file, and called "list.txt"

rosmord
